# Alpha-Fold UI

Alpha-Fold UI: A high-precision interface for protein structure prediction, generating 3D molecular coordinates from amino acid sequences.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Sequence yields idealized CA geometry/Chou-Fasman, not validated high-precision 3D fold prediction. Separate real structure retrieval exists; no learned AlphaFold weights.

text: It provides pLDDT confidence scores and PAE data to evaluate reliability.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: predict_structure labels pLDDT/PAE fields, but docstring and folding_workspace state they are heuristic analogs, not calibrated predictions. Real retrieval routes may return actual source metrics; not reverified in this tranche.

text: Users can visualize predicted structures and download PDB files, enabling functional analysis of novel proteins and the identification of potential binding sites.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: PDB text and candidate site heuristics exist; inspected code/tests, not an actual rendered visualization or verified functional binding site.

# DNA-to-Code

DNA-to-Code: A translation layer that turns complex biological concepts into Python code analogies, helping engineers understand molecular mechanisms through software architecture.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Six curated concepts have Python analogies and explanations; fixed-template educational catalogue, not general conceptual translation.

text: It provides code snippets and explanations for fundamental processes like transcription.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Transcription concept returns a reverse-complement template snippet, explanation and coding-strand execution example ATGT -> AUGU. These conventions differ intentionally; no mechanistic simulator claimed.

text: DNA-to-Code bridges the gap between biological and software engineering, facilitating a deeper understanding of life systems.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Learning/understanding benefit is not measured by implementation or tests.

# Omega Stats

Omega Stats: A performance dashboard for the SugarCode AI platform, tracking prediction accuracy, efficiency rates, and throughput across sub-networks.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Tracks supplied accuracy/latency/throughput/efficiency observations, computes grouped dashboard. This does not auto-establish prediction accuracy of modules.

text: It provides a global view of the system's precision, from chemical scores to clinical simulation times.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Per-module and subnetwork analytics exist for supplied records. No global precision conclusion is justified absent representative observations across tasks/units.

text: Omega Stats ensures transparency and reliability, allowing users to trust AI-guided biological engineering.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Transparent aggregation/uncertainty exists; platform reliability/trust is not guaranteed by a dashboard.
